note: Real registry text, fetched from the ClinicalTrials.gov v2 API. Annotations were read by hand against the source, not taken from extractor output. criteria_text is the complete eligibility section so C3 sees every line; the annotated lines are a seeded random sample (see docs/trial-extraction-validation-plan.md, Corpus).

annotations.line: Male or female patients ≥ 18 years at the day of consenting;
Metastatic disease or unresectable locally advanced malignancy for which standard therapy by anthracycline is decided;
At least one measurable lesion as per RECIST version 1.1.;
